headline: Container Freight Rates Approach Pandemic Record
summary: Container freight rates are nearing pandemic-era highs, with the war in the Middle East cited as a shock to energy markets that has hit container shipping. The rate for a 40-foot container is rising on routes from China to the U.S. East Coast.
why: Container freight rates set the cost of moving manufactured goods across oceans, feeding into retailer margins, inflation and global trade volumes. Container lines such as Maersk are among the largest beneficiaries of rate spikes.
